dataNote: Illustrative demo thresholds, not adopted district policy.

levels.trigger: NWS advisory in effect, snow 1–2.9 in, or wind chill −1 to −9°F
levels.basis: NWS CAP severity; district inclement-weather procedure

levels.trigger: Ice ≥ 0.05 in or snow 3–5.9 in ending before 7 AM, with roads improving by 9 AM
levels.basis: MoDOT road-condition categories; bus operations guidance

levels.trigger: Warning-level hazard starting during school hours: ≥ 2 in snow or any ice before 4 PM
levels.basis: NWS warning onset time; bus route run time

levels.trigger: Wind chill ≤ −20°F during bus-stop hours while roads stay passable
levels.basis: NWS cold-weather warning criteria; Missouri AMI provisions

levels.trigger: NWS Winter Storm, Ice Storm, or Blizzard Warning through the school day, snow ≥ 6 in, ice ≥ 0.25 in, or roads covered
levels.basis: NWS warning taxonomy; district emergency operations plan

sources.title: CAP alert fields
sources.detail: Severity, certainty, and urgency provide structured, nationally consistent hazard screening.

sources.title: Road-condition categories
sources.detail: Clear, partly covered, and covered road reports decide whether bus routes can run on time.

sources.title: Inclement-weather procedure
sources.detail: Snow, ice, and wind-chill cutoffs and essential-staff exceptions reflect bus-stop exposure and site conditions.
